hit.title: Update · Model: gpt-5.6-sol
hit.body: Update · Model: gpt-5.6-sol GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, representing 20% lower input pricing and 33% lower output pricing. GPT-5.6 Sol’s promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026. See [pricing details](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing).
hit.reason: OpenAI model pricing update affects the competitive analysis and cost comparison tables in the OpenAI → Bedrock migration guide, which uses OpenAI pricing as a baseline for recommending Bedrock alternatives.

step1.old_value: GPT-5.6 Sol Bedrock price (≤272K ctx): $4.00 / $20.00 per 1M in/out (already reflecting Nov 2026 price reduction per line 118/122)

step1.still_true: The Bedrock table's $4.00/$20.00 figure for GPT-5.6 Sol already matches this new OpenAI direct price, so the file's numbers are currently accurate and consistent with this announcement.
